title: Variational Wasserstein gradient flow
tldr_zh: 用 f-divergence 变分对偶式替代显式密度项，JKO 步变为 (T,h) min-max，训练时间不随维数增长
tldr_en: Replaces density-dependent functionals in JKO steps by the f-divergence variational form, yielding a primal-dual min-max per step whose cost is dimension-independent.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 unconditional FID 23.1 (JKO-Flow, JSD, a=5, K=30) vs GLOW 45.99, VGrow 28.8, WGAN-GP 31.1, SN-GAN 21.7 (Table 3)
Same-architecture GAN comparison: GAN (a->inf, K=1) >= 80, WGAN-GP 62.3, SN-GAN 43.2, JKO-Flow 23.1 (Table 7); OTM 20.69 / IS 7.41 vs JKO-Flow 23.1 / IS 7.48 (Table 8)
OU process training time per two JKO steps: JKO-ICNN-d 25s (n=2) -> 105s (n=32), JKO-ICNN-a 25 -> 95s, Ours 22+-5s constant (Sec. 5.2)
Bayesian logistic regression, Ours vs JKO-ICNN-d vs SVGD accuracy/LL: covtype 0.753/-0.528 vs 0.75/-0.515 vs 0.75/-0.515; image 0.866/-0.394 vs 0.82/-0.43 vs 0.815/-0.44 (Table 5)
Per-step complexity O(J1 k M H) independent of dimension n vs Mokrov O(J1((k+n)MH + n^3)) (Sec. 3.3); each image JKO step ~20 min (Appendix E.1)
Embedding inequality alpha/2 d_H^2 <= D_f^H <= L/2 d_H^2 for alpha-strongly-convex, L-smooth f (Proposition 4.1(3))
